CustomObject.description: Time Drive's problem log: a source that couldn't be read, or a timeline request that failed, one row per distinct problem (repeats add to its count). Written by Time Drive in system mode; read by admins on the Setup dashboard. Rows not seen for 30 days are removed. Holds what failed and the error's message, not the records read; only admins with Time Drive Setup can read it.
CustomObject.label: Time Drive Log
